newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali Moslem group says Ethiopian troops defect.
newsitem.headline: Somali Moslem group says Ethiopian troops defect.

text.p: Somali Moslem fundamentalist militiamen said on Wednesday 13 Ethiopian Moslem soldiers from the Oromo community had defected to their forces in western Somalia.

Spokesman Ahmed Bile Hassan of al-Ittihad al-Islami (Islamic Unity) movement said 12 Ethiopian men and one woman defected with their weapons on Tuesday to its base at Bohol Garas village from Dolow town, which is on the border with Ethiopia.
He said al-Ittihad gave the Ethiopians a warm welcome and urged other Moslem soldiers in the Ethiopian army to leave.
There was no independent confirmation of the report and no immediate comment from Ethiopia.
Al-Ittihad said earlier this year Ethiopian troops seized Dolow town. Ethiopian troops backed by helicopter gunships thrust into western Somalia last year to hit al-Ittihad bases.
